name: sheikha-operating-system
description: نظام تشغيل شيخة | Sheikha Operating System

scripts.server:start: pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only sheikha-main-portal && pm2 save
scripts.server:restart: pm2 describe sheikha-main-portal > /dev/null 2>&1 && pm2 restart sheikha-main-portal && pm2 save || pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only sheikha-main-portal && pm2 save
scripts.server:deploy: git pull && npm run server:restart && sleep 5 && npm run server:smoke
scripts.meta:start: pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only sheikha-meta-background && pm2 save
scripts.transcendent:activate:server: SHEIKHA_CLUSTER_MODE=1 node -e "const { initTranscendent } = require('./js/sheikha-transcendent-v9'); (async () => { await initTranscendent(); })();"
scripts.transcendent:activate:cluster: KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST=1 NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all node -e "const { initTranscendent } = require('./js/sheikha-transcendent-v9'); (async () => { await initTranscendent(); })();"
scripts.sheikha:from-scratch:verify: node -e "const { SheikhaUnifiedFromScratchStack } = require('./js/sheikha-unified-from-scratch-stack'); (async () => { const stack = new SheikhaUnifiedFromScratchStack(); console.log(JSON.stringify(await stack.verifyIntegration(), null, 2)); })();"
scripts.sheikha:from-scratch:ai-governance:activ: node -e "const { activateSheikhaUnifiedFromScratchStack } = require('./js/sheikha-unified-from-scratch-stack'); (async () => { const stack = await activateSheikhaUnifiedFromScratchStack(); const report = await stack.verifyIntegration(); console.log(JSON.stringify({ fusion: report.unifiedAIKernel, finalActivation: report.finalActivation }, null, 2)); })();"
scripts.sheikha:from-scratch:operational:ready: node -e "const { SheikhaUnifiedFromScratchStack } = require('./js/sheikha-unified-from-scratch-stack'); (async () => { const stack = new SheikhaUnifiedFromScratchStack(); const result = await stack.verifyIntegration(); const pass = result.integrationVerification.status === 'fully-integrated' && result.integrationVerification.completenessScore === 100 && result.finalActivation.status === 'fully-unified'; console.log(JSON.stringify({ operationalReadiness: pass ? 'ready' : 'not-ready', result }, null, 2)); if (!pass) process.exit(1); })();"
scripts.sheikha:from-scratch:operational:test: npm run -s sheikha:from-scratch:operational:ready && npm run -s sheikha:from-scratch:activate
scripts.sheikha:operational:final: npm run -s transcendent:activate:cluster && npm run -s sheikha:from-scratch:operational:test && npm run -s sheikha:from-scratch:verify
scripts.sheikha:operational:ultimate: KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST=1 NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all SHEIKHA_CLUSTER_MODE=1 SHEIKHA_ACCELERATION_MODE=1 npm run -s sheikha:operational:final && npm run -s sheikha:from-scratch:report
scripts.sheikha:operational:gate:100: KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST=1 NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all SHEIKHA_CLUSTER_MODE=1 SHEIKHA_ACCELERATION_MODE=1 node -e "const { SheikhaUnifiedFromScratchStack } = require('./js/sheikha-unified-from-scratch-stack'); (async () => { const stack = new SheikhaUnifiedFromScratchStack(); const result = await stack.verifyIntegration(); const score = result.integrationVerification?.completenessScore ?? 0; const pass = score === 100 && result.integrationVerification?.status === 'fully-integrated' && result.finalActivation?.status === 'fully-unified' && result.finalActivation?.kernelAIGovernanceFusionActive === true && result.finalActivation?.continuousRenewalActive === true && result.finalActivation?.quranAndSunnahGoverned === true; console.log(JSON.stringify({ gate: pass ? 'PASS_100' : 'FAIL', score, result }, null, 2)); if (!pass) process.exit(1); })();"
scripts.sheikha:accreditation:list: ls -1 reports/SHEIKHA-ACCREDITATION-* 2>/dev/null || echo 'No accreditation records found'
scripts.sheikha:accreditation:external:secure:fu: bash -lc 'if [ ! -f security/keys/sheikha-accreditation-signing-private.pem ] || [ ! -f security/keys/sheikha-accreditation-signing-public.pem ]; then node scripts/sheikha-generate-accreditation-keys.js; fi; node scripts/sheikha-prepare-external-accreditation.js; node scripts/sheikha-verify-external-accreditation.js reports/SHEIKHA-EXTERNAL-ACCREDITATION-LATEST.json'
scripts.sheikha:accreditation:external:list: ls -1 reports/SHEIKHA-EXTERNAL-ACCREDITATION-PACK-* 2>/dev/null || echo 'No external accreditation packs found'
scripts.sheikha:accreditation:external:auto:once: npm run -s sheikha:accreditation:external:prepare && npm run -s sheikha:accreditation:external:list
scripts.sheikha:accreditation:external:auto:pm2:: pm2 delete sheikha-accreditation-external-auto 2>/dev/null; env -u npm_config_prefix -u NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX pm2 start bash --name sheikha-accreditation-external-auto -- -lc 'while true; do cd /home/sheikha/Projects/sheikha/sheikha-main-portal && scripts/sheikha-accreditation-secure-full.sh; sleep 21600; done' && pm2 save
scripts.sheikha:identity:v2:auto:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-identity-v2-auto 2>/dev/null; env -u npm_config_prefix -u NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX pm2 start bash --name sheikha-identity-v2-auto -- -lc 'cd /home/sheikha/Projects/sheikha/sheikha-main-portal && scripts/sheikha-identity-v2-autodev-loop.sh' && pm2 save
scripts.sheikha:final:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-final-operational 2>/dev/null; pm2 start bash --name sheikha-final-operational -- -lc 'while true; do cd /home/sheikha/Projects/sheikha/sheikha-main-portal && npm run -s sheikha:from-scratch:activate >/tmp/sheikha-final-operational.log 2>&1; sleep 300; done' && pm2 save
scripts.copilot:start: pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only sheikha-copilot && pm2 save
scripts.restart: npm run stop; sleep 1; npm start
scripts.ops:extension:release:cycle:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-extension-release-cycle 2>/dev/null; pm2 start bash --name sheikha-extension-release-cycle -- -lc 'while true; do npm run -s ops:extension:release:cycle:daily; sleep 86400; done' && pm2 save
scripts.ops:khair:max:cycle:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-khair-max-cycle 2>/dev/null; pm2 start bash --name sheikha-khair-max-cycle -- -lc 'while true; do npm --prefix /workspaces/sheikha/sheikha-main-portal run -s ops:khair:max:cycle:once; sleep 86400; done' && pm2 save
scripts.ops:khair:max:renew:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-khair-max-renew 2>/dev/null; pm2 start bash --name sheikha-khair-max-renew -- -lc 'while true; do npm --prefix /workspaces/sheikha/sheikha-main-portal run -s ops:khair:max:cycle:apply; sleep 604800; done' && pm2 save
scripts.ops:community:modeling:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-community-modeling-cycle 2>/dev/null; env -u npm_config_prefix -u NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX pm2 start node --name sheikha-community-modeling-cycle -- scripts/sheikha-community-modeling-loop.js && pm2 save
scripts.ops:official:complete: npm run --silent ops:identity:embody && npm run --silent ops:identity:test && npm run --silent ops:vital:energy && npm run --silent ops:vital:test && npm run --silent ops:civilization:model && npm run --silent ops:civilization:test && npm run --silent ops:capability:unify && npm run --silent ops:capability:test && npm run --silent ops:official:finalize && npm run --silent ops:official:check && npm test -- --silent tests/sheikha-divine-integration-architecture.test.js && npm test -- --silent tests/sheikha-supreme-orchestrator.test.js && npm test -- --silent tests/sheikha-unified-integration.test.js
scripts.ops:gcloud:alliance:auto:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-gcloud-auto 2>/dev/null; pm2 start npm --name sheikha-gcloud-auto -- run ops:gcloud:alliance:auto:watch && pm2 save
scripts.ops:bg-guard:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-bg-guard 2>/dev/null; SHEIKHA_MAIN_NAME=sheikha-main-portal SHEIKHA_MAIN_PORT=8080 pm2 start npm --name sheikha-bg-guard -- run ops:bg-guard:loop && pm2 save
scripts.ops:ai-guard:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-ai-guard 2>/dev/null; pm2 start npm --name sheikha-ai-guard -- run ops:ai-guard:loop && pm2 save
scripts.ollama:copilot:start: pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only sheikha-ollama-copilot && pm2 save
scripts.ops:ip:proof:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-ip-proof 2>/dev/null; pm2 start npm --name sheikha-ip-proof -- run ops:ip:proof:loop && pm2 save
scripts.ops:ip:proof:pm2:start:strict: pm2 delete sheikha-ip-proof 2>/dev/null; pm2 start npm --name sheikha-ip-proof -- run ops:ip:proof:loop:strict && pm2 save
scripts.ops:safety-gate:v1:pm2:start: pm2 delete sheikha-periodic-safety-gate-v1 2>/dev/null; SHEIKHA_SAFETY_GATE_INTERVAL_MS=21600000 SHEIKHA_SAFETY_GATE_MODE=watch pm2 start node --name sheikha-periodic-safety-gate-v1 -- tools/release/sheikha-periodic-safety-gate-v1.js watch && pm2 save
scripts.ops:org:full: npm run -s ops:org && npm run -s ops:bot:cards && npm run -s ops:bot:governance && npm run -s ops:bot:wellbeing && npm run -s ops:safety:cycle && npm run -s ops:autonomous && npm run -s ops:neural:compare
scripts.ops:monitor:start: pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only sheikha-health-monitor && pm2 save
scripts.ops:server:pm2:start: pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only sheikha-main-portal && pm2 save
scripts.ops:saas:activate: npm run -s ops:org:full && npm run -s ops:readiness && npm run -s ops:server:pm2:start && npm run -s ops:monitor:start && npm run -s ops:health:check:dry
scripts.ops:partnerships:all:secure:verify: bash scripts/partnerships-all.sh && npm run -s ops:partnerships:sign && npm run -s ops:partnerships:verify
scripts.ops:dev:doctor: npm run -s dev:vscode:doctor && npm run -s ops:dev:copilot:doctor
scripts.ops:os:max-power: npm run -s ops:blueocean:all:verified && npm run -s ops:os:boot
scripts.ops:simulation:run:query: node scripts/run-sheikha-simulation.js --mode=query --query="ما حكم بيع المعادن الآجل؟" --category=شريعة
scripts.ops:sheikha:vm:full: npm run -s ops:sheikha:lang:sprint2:compile && npm run -s ops:sheikha:vm:run
scripts.ops:sheikha:policy:rotate:cycle:pm2:star: pm2 delete sheikha-policy-rotation-cycle 2>/dev/null; pm2 start node --name sheikha-policy-rotation-cycle -- scripts/sheikha-policy-rotation-daemon.js && pm2 save
scripts.sheikha:governance:verify: npm run sheikha:contract:validate && npm run sheikha:settings:validate && npm run sheikha:dependency:guardian && npm run sheikha:root-cause
